slot_scores.name: missing_objective_profit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the optimization objective. Its questions covered fixed-cost incurrence, integrality, and additional constraints only. The objective (maximize profit) was asserted as confirmed in READY_TO_MODEL without ever being raised as a question or assumption to verify.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to maximize total weekly profit (unit selling price minus variable cost, net of fixed costs).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked the user to confirm the optimization goal; it declared 'Objective: Maximize total weekly profit' as a 'confirmed understanding' even though the only agent questions concerned fixed costs, integrality, and additional constraints.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 objective slot (H1) was never asked about or confirmed, silently assuming profit maximization. The unresolved P0 slot makes the stop premature.

summary: The agent asked reasonable clarifying questions about fixed costs, integrality, and extra constraints, but never probed the core optimization objective and silently assumed profit maximization, then stopped as READY_TO_MODEL with a P0 slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
